description: This file contains multiple class definitions for Orleans grains, including reentrant, non-reentrant, stream-interacting, and chain-calling grains. It appears to be a core source file implementing various grain behaviors using the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain implementing IReentrantGrain interface, with methods One, Two, and SetSelf.

classes.name: NonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant Orleans grain implementing INonReentrantGrain interface, with methods One, Two, and SetSelf, including logging.

classes.name: MayInterleaveStaticPredicateGrain
classes.description: A grain with static method MayInterleave that determines interleaving based on message arguments, with stream subscription and push capabilities.

classes.name: MayInterleaveInstancedPredicateGrain
classes.description: A grain similar to the static predicate grain but with instance method MayInterleave, supporting stream interactions.

classes.name: UnorderedNonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A simple grain with methods One and Two, supporting self-reference with SetSelf.

classes.name: ReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: A reentrant grain managing internal state with methods to get/set destination and perform a ping delay, with logging.

classes.name: NonReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: Non-reentrant grain with similar self-management as above, with get/set destination and ping delay.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: A grain performing fan-out operations to multiple reentrant or non-reentrant task grains, with chain initialization.

classes.name: FanOutACGrain
classes.description: Similar to FanOutGrain but handles both reentrant and non-reentrant self-managed grains, with chain initialization.

classes.name: ReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain with destination management and ping delay, maintaining a counter.

classes.name: NonReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant grain similar to ReentrantTaskGrain.

classes.name: CallOrderingGrain
classes.description: A grain demonstrating method ordering and interleaving control with a log and unblock mechanism.

methods.name: One
methods.description: Returns a completed task with string 'one'.

methods.name: SetSelf
methods.description: Sets the Self reference to another grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation logic, with some grains logging activation.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a delay and then calls another grain's GetCounter method.

methods.name: MethodA
methods.description: Logs entry, waits on a blocker, logs exit.

methods.name: MethodB
methods.description: Logs entry, waits on a blocker, logs exit.

methods.name: Unblock
methods.description: Completes the blocker task to unblock waiting methods.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the log and resets the blocker.

methods.name: GetLog
methods.description: Returns the current log of method entries.
